# Erdos.p359 — Erdős problem 359

Reference: https://www.erdosproblems.com/359
Imported from google-deepmind/formal-conjectures (`ErdosProblems/359.lean`, theorem `erdos_359.parts.i`, AMS 11).

Let $a_1< a_2 < ⋯ $ be an infinite sequence of integers such that $a_1=1$ and $a_{i+1}$ is the
least integer which is not a sum of consecutive earlier $a_j$s. Show that $a_k / k \to \infty$.

## Statement
∀ (A : ℕ → ℕ) (hA : IsGoodFor A 1), atTop.Tendsto (fun k ↦ (A k : ℝ) / k) atTop
